status: Separate exploratory follow-up after measured-profile rejection; not a blind experiment or a turbulence-energy closure.

source.decay_provenance: Primary Table 1 and section 4.1 centreline law Ujet/Uc=0.165*x/d, with reported B=6.06. Use reported rounded B, not a fitted virtual origin.
source.profile_calibration: Frozen source-only measured_profile_protocol.json calibration; no changes to those fitted curves or source selection.
source.nozzle_assumption: Uniform-density near-top-hat exit; unit nozzle speed, diameter and density imply conserved total momentum flux pi/4. Nozzle stress and finite-domain loss omitted in the accounting estimate.
source.formulas: I1=int eta*f d_eta; I2=int eta*f^2 d_eta; chi=Jmean/Jnozzle=8*B_source^2*I2; alpha_source=2*B_source*I1.
source.meaning: chi is an inferred mean momentum-flux fraction. Jtotal-Jmean is an explicit combined turbulent-normal-stress/pressure flux remainder, NOT a gas momentum sink or SGS kinetic energy.
source.uncertainty: Profile extraction and source integral/decay uncertainty are not available as a joint statistical model. Primary measured total momentum was within 5% of nozzle input; this is not a confidence interval for chi.

assessment.geometry: m(x)=2*alpha*sqrt(pi*rho*Jtotal)*x; reconstruct velocity using Jmean=chi*Jtotal. Retain Jtotal and its remainder explicitly.
assessment.calibration_identity: Using alpha_source must recover B_source=6.06 and native similarity length slope 1 without imposing either after reconstruction.
assessment.holdout: Unchanged Hussein reference.json and 20% local/integral engineering screen. No Hussein stress coefficient or profile fit used in calibration.
assessment.selection: Report all three fixed profile families with both entrainment modes. No coefficient tuning or source selection after evaluating the holdout.
assessment.scope: Integral flux accounting and retrospective profile transfer only. Assumes source chi transfers across Reynolds/nozzle conditions; this remains unvalidated. No stress distribution, pressure field, SGS k, anisotropy or turbulent source term follows from chi alone.
